#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
#define mp make_pair

long long p, k;
const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
long long w[1000100];

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long b)
{
    long long ret = 1;
    while(b)
    {
        if(b&1) ret = ret*a%MOD;
        b >>= 1;
        a = a*a %MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main()
{
    cin >> p >> k;
    if(k == 1)
    {
        cout << pow_mod(p, p) << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    for(long long i=1;i<p;i++)
    {
        w[i] = k*i%p;
    }

    int cnt = 0;
    bool vis[1000100];
    memset(vis, false, sizeof(vis));

    for(int i=1;i<p;i++)
    {
        if(vis[i]) continue;
        int t = i;
        while(!vis[t])
        {
            vis[t] = true;
            t = w[t];
        }
        cnt ++;
    }
    cout << pow_mod(p, cnt) << endl;
    return 0;
}
